acceptanceCriteria: Document native administration versus real worker execution effects with CAL-V0-021/023/026 and same-store disjoint-claim evidence; keep dedicated store qualification/direct shared writes explicit.

Retain actual next-admission evidence for independently scoped private work, preserve historical reservations/unknown coverage, and verify no existing live reservation or acceptance-bound gate is silently reused after a material effects change.
body: Confirmed orchestration configuration friction, not a confirmed Tasks collision-engine defect. During 2026-10-03/04 Corvint batch work, the coordinator added canonical .git/taskman.lock, .git/taskman/, .taskman/ and qualification-probe spellings to every private task as OTHER resources. V1-0668 admission then correctly refused RESOURCE_COLLISION against generation240; further private builds were serialized. Official Tasks build202/Core build163; source DD8 dd8cc0ca918a80faaa041c98a783de11550b2bcc. Expected ordinary supported claim/renew/refine/release bookkeeping uses native transactional administration, while lifetime reservations describe real task execution effects. CAL-V0-021/023/026 and internal/tasks/store/lease_test.go:235-244 demonstrate disjoint claims sharing one store. Read-only independent review /private/tmp/corvint-scheduler-admin-effects-review.md retains exact source and original TCP00 evidence. Correct future declarations prospectively only after true quiescence; SET_EFFECTS is acceptance-changing and refuses live/unknown attempts. Never shrink/ignore live reservations or remove real shared execution effects merely to pass admission. Root coordinator will retain native administration effect inventory and receipts separately; worker source/generated/cache/process/fixture effects remain finite and INCOMPLETE where unknown. Qualification probes exist before lock acquisition; no claim that every administrative effect is under flock. Dedup searches administration and taskman.lock returned zero; bookkeeping only unrelated V1-0632; reservation search confirms existing general store tickets, no matching boundary clarification. Documentation/example should make this distinction explicit and show safe phase transition; no product correctness or speedup qualification claimed from source review. Further confirmed representation friction: #389 terminal proposal repeated 27 /tmp aliases of identical /private/tmp physical producers, hitting the 64 non-PATH-resource cap (81 supplied). Root verified realpath equality and retained the full alias inventory while representing each added producer once: 54 non-PATH keys, all original97 resource entries and77 PATH entries retained. This is operator-side canonical producer mapping, not native OTHER prefix/alias normalization or a runtime cap waiver. Exact refusal and correction are retained under /private/tmp/corvint-codex-batch.S53nDh/389-main-plan/init56/32aa/fixture-repair/. Future collision comparisons must use actual producer identity, never opaque-key inequality alone.
title: Agent orchestration: do not reserve native administrative store traffic for entire task lifetimes
